profile.name: Maurice Simmons
profile.title: Cloud Strategy & Operations Manager, DevOps & Cloud Engineering Student at Purdue Univerisity
profile.tagline: I design, automate, and deploy reliable software across the full delivery lifecycle, from initial commit to production in the cloud. I’m seeking opportunities to apply my skills in CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and cloud operations to help teams ship faster and with confidence
profile.valueProposition: I align technical execution with business strategy by bridging the gap between code and infrastructure. Leveraging Google Cloud, application containerization, and CI/CD automation, I architect highly observable and repeatable systems. My focus is on delivering frictionless, scalable environments that reduce operational risk, accelerate deployment cycles, and empower cross-functional teams to drive measurable value.
profile.availability: Open to internships Spring 2027, Summer 2027, and CO-OP opportunities throuhg out the 2027 calendar year.
about: I'm a miltiary veteran and student focused on DevOps, cloud engineering, and AI integration . I like taking something that works on my laptop and making it work reliably for everyone else.
Lately I've been working with Docker, GitHub Actions, and Google Cloud Run, and with AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code, Google Gemnini, and Grok to move faster without giving up quality.

projects.title: Cloud Run Portfolio
projects.description: This site. It's a React front end served by an Express API, packaged as a Docker image and deployed to Google Cloud Run automatically on every push to main through GitHub Actions.

projects.title: AI Cyber Security Integration
projects.description: Integrated machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing—into an organization's security infrastructure to automate, accelerate, and enhance the detection and mitigation of cyber threats

projects.title: Systems Integrator
projects.description: Directed critical IT infrastructure and communications integration across remote operational combat sites in Iraq. Serving as the primary enterprise liaison between two military division commands.

projects.title: CI/CD Pipeline Lab
projects.description: A GitHub Actions pipeline that lints, tests, and builds a containerized service on every pull request, then publishes a versioned image to Artifact Registry when a merge lands on main.

projects.title: Linux Server Automation
projects.description: Bash scripts that provision a fresh Linux VM: they create users, harden SSH, configure a firewall, and install a monitored web server, so a manual hour of setup takes a few minutes.

projects.title: Uptime Status Dashboard
projects.description: A small service that checks a list of endpoints on a schedule, records response times, and shows current status and history on a dashboard, with alerts when a site goes down.
